strings.compare.p.book_on_ug_where: Yi rijista a UG inda akwai hanya, Kira tukuna inda babu, Yana cikin jerin don sanin sa, Yana zuwa ga abin da ake ginawa. Farashi kiyasi ne kuma yana faɗi haka.

strings.rent.h2.rent_the_car_or: Ka tuƙa da kanka a rana. Da direba a awa.

strings.deliver.p.every_courier_in_town: Duk masu jigilar kaya a birni a allo ɗaya, an jera su. A jihohi, kunshin yana tafiya a cikin akwatin motar tasha kan kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu na kujera, kuma a lokacin girbi minibus, pickup ko babbar mota da direba.

strings.deliver.p.courier_rates_are_ug: Farashin masu jigilar kaya kiyasin UG ne daga hanyar da aka buga; an ambaci 8 to 8 a Jinja daga takardar wanda ya kafa kuma farashinsa kiyasi ne. Kunshi a Tasha farashin UG ne: kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu na kujera a wannan tasha, ana biyan direba tare da kujeru.

strings.explore.p.park_entry_permits_vehicle: Shiga wurin shakatawa, takardun izini, kuɗin mota, wurin kwana, kuɗin abinci da hanya, an lissafa duka ga 'yan ƙasar Afirka ta Gabas, baƙin da ke zaune a nan da baƙi. 'Yan ƙasar Afirka ta Gabas suna biyan farashin Afirka ta Gabas.

strings.drive.p.no_posting_no_waiting: Babu sanyawa, babu jira a tasha, babu gasa. Taswirar jin daɗinka ita ce kaɗai abin da kake kula da shi: sansani, nisa, hanyoyi, awanni, da abin da ba ka yarda da shi ba. Tafiye-tafiyen da aka biya suna zuwa da kuɗi a ciki.
strings.drive.summary.where_demand_is_coming: Inda buƙata ke zuwa wannan mako <small>Foresight · girbi, bukukuwa da abubuwan da suka faru, mako gaba, bisa nau'in mota</small>
strings.drive.p.promise_to_be_there: Yi alkawarin za ka kasance sannan giɓin ya rufe ga kowa. Ana nuna tabbaci ga kowane alama; lokutan shekara dokoki ne har girbi na farko ya koya musu.
strings.drive.span.confidence_is_shown_per: Ana nuna tabbaci ga kowane alama; lokutan shekara dokoki ne har sai an sami tafiye-tafiye cike da za a koya daga gare su.

strings.install.p.ride_pool_rent_deliver: Hau. Raba. Yi hayar. Aika. Kasuwar sufuri ta Uganda ga mutanen da ke da inda za su je da kasafin kuɗin da za su girmama.

strings.ops.p.every_town_on_the: Kowane gari a taswira hanya ce daga Kampala kuma tasha ce ta kanta. Inda app na cikin gida ya riga yana aiki, UG tana ba shi tafiyar ƙarshe maimakon ta yi kamar tana can.

strings.ops.h2.maps_from_felt_climate: Taswirori daga Felt. Ayyukan yanayi daga Infrared City. Nishaɗi daga Tazama. Sarrafa da murya daga Cephable.
strings.ops.p.each_plug_in_is: Kowane ƙari yana da inda yake zuwa da maɓallinsa, ana ajiye su a wannan na'ura har sai ka shiga. Haɗa ɗaya sannan maɓallan da suka dace su buɗe a Pool, Bincika da Hustle Mode. Babu abin da ke fita daga UG sai ka buɗe ƙari.

strings.ops.h2.competitors_are_listed_on: An sanya masu gasa da mu a jerin da gangan. Fasinjan da ya amince da kwatancen yana dawowa don pool da haya.
strings.ops.p.ug_is_a_marketplace: UG kasuwa ce da farko. App ɗin tafiye-tafiye suna samun rijista cike ba tare da kuɗin nemo abokan ciniki ba. Wuraren haya suna samun masu haya da aka duba. Otal-otal suna samun ƙungiyoyi masu zuwa a ranar da aka sani. Direbobi suna samun hanya cike kafin su tashi.
strings.ops.p.verified_drivers_and_plates: Direbobi da lambobi da aka tabbatar, maɓallin taimako a cikin tafiya da ke raba inda kake da mutumin da ka zaɓa, hulunan kai a kowace bodar da aka raba, da rasit ga kowane shilling.
strings.ops.p.ten_percent_on_pool: Kashi goma cikin ɗari a pool, kuɗi ɗaya na sanyawa a haya, biya kowane mako zuwa MoMo ta Flutterwave, da abokan ciniki da ba sai ka yi talla ba.

strings.ops.p.deep_links_that_open: Mahaɗai da ke buɗe app ɗinka da inda za a ɗauke ka da inda za ka sauka cike. Ba mu taɓa nuna farashin da ba mu lissafa a fili ba, kuma an buga hanyar.
